name: soundadam-lark
description: Claude Code marketplace for explicit-invocation Lark/Feishu CLI skills. Vendored from larksuite/cli so they can be hidden from the model's skill listing.

plugins.name: lark-cli
plugins.description: Explicit-invocation Lark/Feishu skills: /lark-cli:lark-doc and /lark-cli:lark-wiki. Both set disable-model-invocation, so they stay out of the always-on skill listing and cost nothing until you type them. Requires the lark-cli binary (bun add -g @larksuite/cli).
